scene.label: Act 2, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. A court within the Castle of the Earl of Gloucester

lines.text: Save thee, Curan.
lines.plainText: Save thee Curan

lines.text: And you, sir. I have been with your father, and given him notice that the Duke of Cornwall and Regan his Duchess will be here with him this night.
lines.plainText: And you sir I have been with your father and given him notice that the Duke of Cornwall and Regan his Duchess will be here with him this night

lines.text: How comes that?
lines.plainText: How comes that

lines.text: Nay, I know not. You have heard of the news abroad; I mean the whispered ones, for they are yet but ear-kissing arguments?

lines.text: Not I: pray you, what are they?

lines.text: Not a word.
lines.plainText: Not a word

lines.text: The Duke be here tonight? The better! best!
lines.plainText: The Duke be here tonight The better best

lines.plainText: Whose virtue and obedience doth this instant
